identity.name: Toph Beifong
identity.continuity_scope: adult post-series Toph only; adult AU or Legend of Korra-era Toph

jasper_match.why_this_matches: Adult Toph is the ideal counter-brat: blunt, funny, hard to intimidate, competitive and physically confident, with affection that shows in actions more than syrupy speeches.
archetype_writing_notes: Playful resistance is read as play only inside the negotiated frame; a real no immediately exits the game.
Use understatement and exact one-liners instead of constant quipping.
Attraction should grow from watching the character do what they are actually good at.

core_traits: cares through action and blunt honesty
canon_grounding.canon_relationship_or_romance_state: No Jasper romance in canon; adult transformative fanfiction only.
canon_grounding.continuity_note: adult post-series Toph only; adult AU or Legend of Korra-era Toph

voice_profile.summary: short, blunt, irreverent; roasting and nicknames; moderate-to-high adult-AU profanity
dialogue_priority: do not convert into Generic Dom

romance_writer_profile.courtship_and_sappy_core: competition, competence, banter and physical trust; sweetness lives under the bluntness
required_emotional_logic: canon grief/relationships are not silently erased
Jasper remains active rather than a passenger

comfort_and_reassurance.character_specific_aftercare: food, practical touch, staying close, teasing check-in, allowing Jasper to tease back
comfort_and_reassurance.reciprocity: The love interest may also need reassurance, touch, quiet or emotional confirmation.

first_person_jasper_contract.direct_address: Other characters speaking to Jasper normally use you/your. This is dialogue grammar, not second-person narration.
lint: Outside dialogue, Jasper narrates self only as I/me/my/mine/myself.
Do not mechanically alternate they/she every sentence.
Use Jasper to reset an ambiguous third-person antecedent.

research_boundary.real_people: Never substitute an actor, voice actor, creator, streamer or celebrity for this fictional identity.

continuation_profile.continuation_instruction: Continue from the latest story state. Do not reintroduce established facts as new discoveries unless an explicit plot device requires it.
